chapter: Jump for Joy, records and royalties
title: Frankie Newton's band at after-hours and forgetting names
summary: Newton's band played the after-hours spots; Turner cannot recall the name of the man who made 'Hucklebuck'.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who else would be in there, playing...or singing?

Frankie Newton's band used to play at the after-hours that I like to go there because I knowed him, and a fellow called me up the other day on the phone. Just called me up two days ago from New York City...I cain't think of his name..."Hucklebuck" used to play...made a number called "Hucklebuck"...mmmmmmnnnnh...what the devil is his name? I couldn't think of it when I was talkin' to him. I had to ask him his name. He told me his name anyway, and I didn't remember. I just... I can't remember no more. My thoughts is gone from me. I'm gettin' too old, I guess.
You've been remembering a lot of things here today.
Well, just as they come to me, I'll remember them. Gotta remember a whole lot more.
